title: Miami City Sightseeing Double Decker Bus Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Miami from the comfort of a double decker bus, led by a live guide. This tour is perfect for those short on time, providing a convenient way to see the city's highlights in one loop. Capture stunning photos as you pass iconic landmarks and enjoy multiple departures daily from South Beach, making it easy to fit into your schedule. 

- Experience the city on an open-top double decker bus
- Live guide sharing insights about Miami's attractions
- Ideal for travelers on a time crunch
- Convenient departures from South Beach throughout the day
- Great for first time visitors
